allies.rationale_text: Experimentation gives lean-startup-methodology the concrete test loop it needs to turn fragile product beliefs into validated learning.
allies.source_quote: validated learning through rapid, focused experimentation
allies.affinity_rationale: LSM IS a framework for systematic experimentation — 'the continuous validation loop (Measure/Learn) is the formal application of the scientific method — testing hypotheses and iterating based on results'.
allies.activation_condition: When product or market hypotheses need to be tested through structured build-measure-learn cycles rather than theoretical analysis or intuition-based development

allies.rationale_text: Empathy helps lean-startup-methodology measure the right user reality instead of optimizing a product around internal assumptions.
allies.affinity_rationale: LSM depends on deep customer empathy through its Design Thinking alliance — 'synthesizing qualitative data to build understanding' of customer needs drives the hypothesis formation process.
allies.activation_condition: When the build-measure-learn cycle requires genuine understanding of customer pain points rather than internal assumptions about what users need

antagonists.rationale_text: Status-quo-bias pushes lean-startup-methodology back toward premature planning and continuation when evidence should force change.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Legacy delivery cadence blocks build-measure-learn iteration — LSM 'explicitly acknowledges that business systems are living systems not amenable to mechanical, step-by-step beliefs'.
antagonists.activation_condition: When organizational inertia and traditional linear delivery processes resist the rapid iteration and pivoting that lean methodology demands

structured_tensions.tension_text: Lean-startup-methodology conflicts with commitment-bias when founders keep scaling a cherished plan after real-world evidence weakens the original thesis.
structured_tensions.source_quote: the methodology demands an active openness to new ideas and data

structured_tensions.tension_text: Lean-startup-methodology conflicts with status-quo-bias when the team interprets thin traction as permission to continue rather than to pivot or stop.
structured_tensions.source_quote: used to trigger real continuation, pivot, or kill decisions

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete.
